meta.name: product-launch-video
meta.description: Turn a product or marketing URL, pasted script, or brief into a product launch / promo video — SaaS promos, feature reveals, product demos, app and company launches. Use when the user wants to market, launch, promote, or reveal a product; the default for any commercial URL. Site tours / showcases of a website route here too — the brief carries the show-it-as-is intent. Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把产品链接或一段文案变成一支产品发布宣传片
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果手上只有产品链接或一段文案,却要快速做出一支能直接投放的发布短片。
copy.tagline_en: Turn a product link or a short brief into a launch promo video
copy.fit_line_en: For you if all you have is a product link or a brief but need a ready-to-post launch video.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会把产品 URL、粘贴的脚本或简述,按步骤做成产品发布/宣传视频:抓取素材、定设计系统、写分镜与脚本、逐帧搭建,最后渲染出 video.mp4。
howto.when: 当你想推广、发布或揭晓一个产品时触发;商业 URL 默认走这里,网站巡览/展示类请求也归这里;意图不明确则先走 /hyperframes。

say.text: 帮我把我们的官网做成一支产品发布视频
say.note: 会先抓取站点作为素材,再逐步搭建

say.text: 这是我的产品简介,做成发布视频
say.note: 简述会先锁定成 BRIEF.md 再进入搭建

say.text: 把这份脚本做成产品演示视频
say.note: 脚本会原样保存,再按流程逐帧搭建

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude turns a product or marketing URL, a pasted script, or a brief into a launch/promo video: it captures assets, picks a design system, writes the storyboard and script, builds frames, and renders video.mp4.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you want to market, launch, or reveal a product; commercial URLs default here, and site tours/showcases also route here; unclear intent goes to /hyperframes first.

say_en.text: Turn our website into a product launch video
say_en.note: It captures the site first, then builds step by step

say_en.text: Here's my product brief — make a launch video
say_en.note: The brief is locked into BRIEF.md before building

say_en.text: Turn this script into a product demo video
say_en.note: The script is saved verbatim, then built out
